NONE: › to make someone a member of the nobility (= highest social rank)
› literary to make something or someone better so that people admire it, him, or her more
使更崇高，使更高尚；使更尊貴

example: He has this theory that suffering can ennoble a person's character.
他認爲苦難可以使一個人的人格變得高尚。

NONE: › a feeling of being bored and mentally tired caused by having nothing interesting or exciting to do
（由於無所事事而感到的）無聊，厭倦，倦怠

example: The whole country seems to be affected by the ennui of winter.
冬天的倦怠感似乎影響著整個國家。
